observations: Function `collect(item, bucket=None)` accepts an item and an optional bucket argument.
When `bucket is None`, a new empty list is assigned to the local name `bucket` before appending.
The append and return lines are unchanged; only the default-handling lines are marked changed.
The stated contract is that omitted-bucket calls each receive a fresh bucket, while explicit buckets are mutated in place.
Probe p1 exercises two omitted-bucket calls and returns snapshots of the resulting lists.
Probe p2 exercises an explicit bucket argument `[9]`, which the contract says is modified in place.
